messages.text: Thursday, September 24 · Canton, Michigan
Autumn's first crisp air, jazz notes, and a town's future
A mostly clear Thursday arrives with crisp autumn air and a high near 70°F. Look for jazz performances in Ann Arbor and discussions on Ann Arbor's downtown property sale.
Expect a mostly clear day with a high near 70°F and a low around 51°F, with no chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:24 AM and sunset is at 7:27 PM, with the moon appearing as a waxing gibbous, 93.4% illuminated.
Ann Arbor's evening sounds and sights
For a taste of jazz, consider Fresh Berrys. at El Limon at 6:00 PM, or Pianist Barron Ryan at Kerrytown Concert House at 7:30 PM.
Evil Gigawatt's birthday is today, September 24.
Ann Arbor plans for downtown property sale funds
Ann Arbor City Council has approved a spending plan for the $14.2 million to $17.4 million expected from the sale of the city-owned Kline’s lot. The funds will be allocated to 12 different projects.
Friday brings film and music
Tomorrow, catch a free outdoor screening of 'Best in Show' at Campus Martius Park in Detroit, or attend Dolly Day at the Ann Arbor District Library.
Satellites navigate without GPS, new cancer treatment advances

NASA's Starling satellites have demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation using onboard cameras and star catalogs. The University of Michigan has established a $10 million Histotripsy Center to advance non-invasive cancer treatments using soundwaves.
The Starship launch schedule is unset, with no official date listed for its next attempt.
A clear sky offers many paths to discovery.
Friday, September 25 · Canton, Michigan
Full Moon Rises Over Overcast Autumn Skies

An overcast but mild autumn day is here, with a full moon expected tonight. The local focus is on Ann Arbor's plans for downtown property sale funds, while science news highlights NASA's advances in autonomous satellite navigation.
Expect an overcast day with a high near 68°F and a low around 45°F.
Sunrise is at 7:25 AM, sunset at 7:26 PM, and the nearly full moon will be 97.6% illuminated.
Nearby Events and Gatherings

In Ann Arbor, catch pianist Barron Ryan at Kerrytown Concert House at 6:30 PM, or celebrate Dolly Parton at the Ann Arbor District Library at 5:30 PM. Detroit offers a free screening of 'Best in Show' at Campus Martius Park at 7:00 PM.
The next new moon is scheduled for October 10.
Ann Arbor's Downtown Property Sale Funds Allocation

Ann Arbor City Council has approved a spending plan for the anticipated $14.2 million to $17.4 million from the sale of the city-owned Kline's lot. The funds will be directed toward 12 distinct projects, including affordable housing and sustainable energy.
Tomorrow and Beyond

Tomorrow, Ypsilanti kicks off The Big Read at the Michigan Library Plaza at 11:00 AM, featuring performances and speakers. In Detroit, the Dossin Great Lakes Museum hosts Dossin After-Dark this evening at 6:00 PM.
Autonomous Navigation and Lunar Landing Tests

NASA's Starling satellites have successfully demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation using onboard cameras and space object catalogs. Additionally, NASA has begun critical lunar landing plume tests, measuring crater formation and ejecta to refine rocket exhaust models.
Starship's next launch attempt is not officially scheduled, but estimates suggest no earlier than September 18, 2026.
The evening sky offers a canvas for reflection.
